review.note: MDC describes the Gasconade as free-flowing. Each reviewed agency landing pair and downstream chain follows the visible river corridor. The older watershed assessment is background evidence, not a current navigability report. Geometry, endpoint and mileage checks pass. This does not establish current floatability, enable GPS ETA or change calculator distances.
